content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for SU Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Jobs entail extensive travel within Sikkim. Both Field Investigators will be expected to work jointly and in close coordination. Desirable: Knowledge of local/vernacular language(s)

content_sections.heading: SU Job Description
content_sections.text: Both Field Investigators will be expected to undertake the following duties: Work jointly and in close coordination throughout the project duration. Conduct fieldwork across study areas in Sikkim. Carry out data collection and documentation. Handle other project-related activities assigned by the Principal Investigators. Undertake extensive travel within the State of Sikkim as required by the study.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: M.Sc. (Geology/Environmental Science) and related fields. Pay: 20,000 + HRA @ 9%. Qualification required: M.Sc./M.A.(Psychology) and related fields. Pay: 20,000 + HRA @ 9%.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially the appointment will be made for three months and may be extended till project completion. Appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How Will SU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on application Interview in hybrid mode (offline and online) Hybrid mode interview (both offline and online)

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through email. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview at Sikkim University, Gangtok. Selected candidate is expected to join immediately after appointment.

content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Sikkim University, dated 27 October 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.
